name: io.github.cantorfi/cantorfi-mcp
title: CantorFi lending vaults and agent door
description: CantorFi on Base: vaults, positions, unsigned transactions, x402 paid services, apps built on it.

tools.name: cantorfi_vaults
tools.description: Live state of every CantorFi isolated lending vault: token, supplied, borrowed, available liquidity, utilization, borrow and supply APR, borrow limit, liquidation threshold and liquidation bonus.

tools.name: cantorfi_vault
tools.description: Live state of one CantorFi vault, chosen by token symbol (USDC, WETH), vault id or vault address.

vault.description: Token symbol, vault id or vault address

tools.name: cantorfi_contracts
tools.description: Network, chain id, deployment block and addresses of the CantorFi contracts: protocol registry, vault factory, reader, price oracle and every vault with its token, receipt token and staking contract.

tools.name: cantorfi_liquidation_bot
tools.description: How to run the open-source CantorFi liquidation bot: read-only without a key, or liquidating with the user's own wallet. Returns the repository and the commands filled with the network values.

tools.name: cantorfi_apps
tools.description: Applications registered in the CantorFi integrator registry, read from the chain: name, site and the endpoint where an agent reads and acts in each application. One connection to CantorFi finds them all.

tools.name: cantorfi_position
tools.description: What one wallet has supplied and owes in each CantorFi vault: supply, debt with interest, what it can still borrow, what it can withdraw and its health factor.

tools.name: cantorfi_prepare
tools.description: Unsigned transactions for one CantorFi action, ready to be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet: a vault action (supply, borrow, repay, withdraw), staking of the vault receipt token CVT (stake with a lock of 1 to 365 days, unstake once the lock has ended, claim_rewards), or a swap between USDC, WETH and ETH through the CantorFi router with a minimum received. Nothing is signed or sent by this server.

vault.description: Token symbol, vault id or vault address (vault actions and staking)

amount.description: Amount in token units (CVT for stake, the sold token for swap), digits with an optional decimal point, for example 25.5

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

lockDays.description: Lock of a stake in days, 30 by default (stake)

slippage.description: Accepted price move in percent, 1 by default (swap)

tools.name: cantorfi_paid_services
tools.description: Services an agent pays per call in USDC with x402: resource, price, input and how to pay. No account and no key on the server: the agent's own wallet signs a USDC authorization, without gas.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search CantorFi vaults and guides (isolated lending, liquidations, prediction market settlement, B20 tokens, ERC-4626); returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full record of one CantorFi vault or full text of one guide, by id (from search).
